title: Abraham's Death and Isaac's Family

questions.question: Who were Rebekah's twin sons?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:24-26: Rebekah gave birth to twins, Esau and Jacob.

questions.question: What did Esau sell to Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:33: Esau sold his birthright to Jacob.

questions.question: How old was Abraham when he died?
Who inherited everything Abraham had?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:5: Abraham gave all he had to Isaac.

questions.question: Where was Abraham buried?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:9: Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham in the cave of Machpelah.

questions.question: Who was Abraham's wife after Sarah died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:1: Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

questions.question: What did Esau trade his birthright for?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:34: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew for his birthright.

questions.question: Which twin was born first?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:25: The first came out red and hairy, and they named him Esau.

questions.question: How old was Isaac when the twins were born?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:26: Isaac was 60 years old when Rebekah bore them.

questions.question: Why did Rebekah struggle during pregnancy?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:22: The children struggled together within her.

questions.question: What did God tell Rebekah about her twins?
options: Two nations, the older will serve the younger
questions.correctAnswer: Two nations, the older will serve the younger
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:23: "the older shall serve the younger."

questions.question: What did Jacob mean in Hebrew?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:26: Jacob's name relates to grasping Esau's heel at birth.

questions.question: What did Esau become?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:27: Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field.

questions.question: Who buried Abraham?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:9: Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him.

questions.question: How many sons did Ishmael have?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:16: These are the twelve princes according to their tribes.

key_verse_text: "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you shall be divided; the one shall be stronger than the other, the older shall serve the younger."
